name: Adv. Rajesh A. Thosar
shortDescription: Advocate in Ulhasnagar, Thane, practising before the Bombay High Court, District & Sessions Courts, Magistrate Courts and Consumer Commissions in Maharashtra.
biography: Adv. Rajesh A. Thosar is an Advocate enrolled with the Bar Council of Maharashtra & Goa, practising before the Bombay High Court, District and Sessions Courts, Magistrate Courts, Consumer Commissions and various other judicial and quasi-judicial forums in Maharashtra.

He handles a range of matters including civil and criminal litigation, property and succession disputes, banking and financial recovery matters, cheque dishonour cases, consumer disputes, matrimonial matters, constitutional and writ proceedings, and matters before various statutory and regulatory authorities.

His practice involves legal research, drafting and advocacy, with emphasis on understanding the factual and legal aspects of each matter before settling the approach to it. He regularly drafts petitions, applications, appeals, written submissions, replies, affidavits, agreements and other legal documents.
He conducts his practice in accordance with the professional standards of the Bar and maintains the confidentiality of client matters.
